title: Skyward
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: On a besieged planet where humanity hides from alien attackers, a teenage girl wants to be a fighter pilot. Her father was branded a coward, and she must win a place in the training school despite it.
readIf: you like a determined young heroine and a fast space-fighter story with real heart.
skipIf: you want hard science fiction, as the flying is exciting but the physics is loose.

pairings.reason: Another young person trained for a war against alien forces, with a heavier look at cost and manipulation.
A comparable teen heroine with a stained family name and a fierce will to prove herself.
A harder-edged coming-of-age story in a ruthless military school setting.
